peter: Quick sync — found a compatibility edge where runtime 4.4's kvcache reorder exposes a race with quant-v2 models on older NGC drivers. It's causing intermittent 5xx for batched longseq (>6k). Proposing a short pin in eu-west-2 during a maintenance window tonight 22:00-22:30 UTC.

ana: Can you share incidence numbers? Is it customer-facing or only internal tests?

peter: Customer-facing: ~0.35% of longseq batch requests see kv-index-exhaust -> 502. Crash log id crash-kv-129. Repro with `tests/longseq/kv_repro --model quant-v2 --len 6500 --batch 16`.

mira: Ops: prefer a config pin for kvcache=stable rather than full runtime rollback to avoid losing optimizer kernels. Regional pin eu-west-2 only.

ops: I can apply config pin. Command we expect: `/deploybot pin config=kvcache_mode=stable region=eu-west-2 reason="kv-race-quantv2" actor=peter`

deploybot: (bot) Please confirm: execute `/deploybot pin config=kvcache_mode=stable region=eu-west-2 actor=peter reason="kv-race-quantv2"` to apply.

peter: Confirm. Also add SDK note: SDK v3.10 surfaces the race due to altered batching behavior; recommend marking v3.10 as "partial incompatibility" with runtime 4.4 for longseq until patch.

ops: Pin applied. Anchor ID anchor-4951-kv. Canary at 10% for 20m started (r-euw-512).

mira: Observability 25m: canary error down 90%, p99 latency unchanged. Proceed to 50% then 100% if no regressions.

peter: I'll open PR for runtime 4.4.1 with a kv-index guard and a fallback to serialized cache rebuild. Link will be in this thread.

ops: 100% roll to pinned config completed at 22:18 UTC. Leaving anchor for 12h while patch lands. Audit id audit-4951 recorded.

deploybot: (bot) Anchor anchor-4951-kv will expire at 2026-04-01T10:18Z unless extended. To extend: `/deploybot anchor extend anchor-4951-kv duration=12h`.
